version.cant_any_more: Your taf can't do this any more.
version.card_note.issues: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming once issues these Cards in KIFF, then this version goes live.
version.card_note.issues_biometry: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming with {biometry} once issues these Cards in KIFF, then this version goes live.
version.card_note.removes: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming once issues these Cards in KIFF and removes the ones this version doesn't have, then this version goes live.
version.card_note.removes_biometry: While it switches, your taf doesn't run. Confirming with {biometry} once issues these Cards in KIFF and removes the ones this version doesn't have, then this version goes live.
version.card_out_of_date: Version {n|possessive} Card is out of date: a Card changed since it was drafted. Draft it again, then read it before you approve.
version.card_unreadable: This version's Card couldn't be read.
version.coach_unknown_taf: Coach asked to install a version of a taf that isn't here.
version.doesnt_run_until: Your taf doesn't run until it's installed or you cancel.
version.first_only: One version so far. When you improve it, each change is kept here.
version.go_back_body: Version {version|possessive} trial Card stops at once, and this chat is deleted. {taf} keeps working as it is.
version.go_back_title: Go back to the live version?
version.guide.give_task: Give it a task that uses the change, as you would the live {name}.
version.guide.install_or_back: Install makes it the live version; Go back ends the trial.
version.guide.keeps_working: {name} keeps working as it is. What this version does is real, under its own Card.
version.guide.trial_ends: The trial ends {date} if you don't use it.
version.install_body: Version {version} becomes the live version, with its Card. This chat is deleted.
version.install_unconfirmed: Installing version {n} didn't finish: KIFF didn't confirm its Card. {why} Your taf doesn't run until you finish or cancel it.
version.install_unfinished: Installing version {n} didn't finish. {why} Your taf doesn't run until you finish or cancel it.
version.intro: Installing a version makes it the live version, forward or back. One confirmation covers it.
version.not_a_trial.confirmed: KIFF didn't start a trial: it issued these Cards as the taf's own. Check its Card tab, or install the version you had.
version.not_a_trial.other: KIFF didn't start a trial for this version (it answered {status}). Nothing runs under it.
version.out_of_date_card: What you're asked to approve changed since it was shown. Read it again, then approve.
version.prompt.install: Install version {n} of {taf}, with its Card
version.prompt.use_coach: Use version {n} of {taf}, as Coach asked
version.prompt.use_with_card: Use version {n} of {taf}, with its Card
version.prompt.use_with_card_coach: Use version {n} of {taf}, with its Card, as Coach asked
version.title: Versions
version.trial.card_not_read: Version {n|possessive} trial Card couldn't be read. {why}
version.trial.changed: What you're asked to approve changed since it was shown. Read it again, then start.
version.trial.prompt: Try version {n} of {taf}, with its own Card
version.trial_card_unreadable: This trial's Card couldn't be read.
version.try_first: Try a version first: you chat with it under a Card of its own, while the live version keeps working.
version.while_you_try.chat: You chat with version {n} in its own window. What it does is real: its calls go through KIFF under the Card below.
version.while_you_try.counts_from_zero: The trial's Card counts from zero, so on a day your taf can spend its live Card's limits plus this one's.
version.while_you_try.ends: It ends when you install it or go back, or after 7 days unused. Its chat is then deleted, and Versions keeps one line about it.
version.while_you_try.live_keeps_working: The live version keeps working: its schedule, Card and budget don't change.
